proofLimits: Four new privacy/consent/context components through two fresh archive/source installation profiles. Closed host-state and older packets are not replayed.

React 19.2.8 and TypeScript 5.9.3, four installed privacy/consent/context SSR profiles and strict public types. Reports are supplied data. Consent and handoff intents grant no permission and send no values. No network, payment, renewal, authorization or provider operation is performed.
Seven locally generated archives are not public npm package-name installs. Fresh transitive locks are retained rather than equated with the workspace lock.
The outer supervisor checks observed command groups and final scratch removal. This helper checks its direct children, streams and original groups; no complete machine-wide namespace scan is claimed.
